name: OmniRoute
hook: Free AI gateway that routes Claude Code across 352 providers — 150+ with free tiers delivering 1.47B tokens/month at zero cost. Point Claude Code at localhost:20128/v1 and get automatic fallback, RTK+Caveman stacked compression (15–95% token savings on top), and 17 routing strategies. @charlieautomates built a full 'Claude Code Is Now FREE Forever' tutorial around it; 61.5k GitHub stars.

name: Claude Commerce Agents
hook: Anthropic's open-source reference blueprint (Sept 2, Apache 2.0) for shopping and merchant agents — catalog search, cart building, inventory, pricing, and campaign management across retail, travel, telecom, and entertainment. Runs on Anthropic API, Bedrock, Vertex, or Foundry from one codebase; includes a Claude Code plugin and pre-built skills. Launch partners: Accenture, Mastercard, Visa.

name: trace-mcp
hook: MCP server that indexes your repo once and serves a framework-aware dependency graph — cuts median PR-review context from 13,595 to 1,326 input tokens (90.6% reduction across 60 open-source PRs). Supports 81 languages, 87 framework integrations (Laravel, Django, FastAPI, NestJS, Vue, React…), 7 ORMs. Zero telemetry, MIT, 133 stars.
install: npm install -g trace-mcp && trace init && trace add

name: Inference Hooks (Claude Enterprise)
hook: Inference hooks entered beta for Claude Enterprise — an open webhook protocol that lets your security server inspect every prompt and tool call before Claude sees it and return allow/deny in real time. One org-level config covers claude.ai, Cowork, MCP servers, skills, plugins, and Claude Code simultaneously. Integrates with Netskope, Palo Alto, Proofpoint, and Zscaler out of the box. Distinct from the enterprise-frontier-safeguards (activity logs + data retention) announced Sept 1.

name: PAUL
hook: Plan-Apply-Unify Loop for Claude Code — 26 commands enforce a three-phase cycle (Plan with BDD acceptance criteria → Apply via Execute/Qualify per-task loops → Unify with mandatory closure comparing planned vs. actual). STATE.md persists context across sessions; BASE v2 integration tracks cost attribution. @charlieautomates called PAUL + SEED 'the Claude Code meta nobody's talking about.' 1.2k stars.

name: SEED
hook: Typed project incubator for Claude Code — five built-in project types (Application, Workflow, Client, Utility, Campaign) shape the exploration conversation, produce a structured PLANNING.md, and graduate plans into PAUL-managed builds with zero re-asking. Installs to ~/.claude/commands/seed/ for workspace-wide availability. 346 stars; featured by @charlieautomates as the front-half of the SEED+PAUL pipeline.

name: Reticle
hook: Verification layer that lets AI agents confirm their code changes actually work — instead of screenshots or guesses, agents observe the live running app (network responses, store state, console errors, React commits) and receive pass/fail verdicts with file:line pointers. Ships as a Claude Code plugin (one-word /reticle command) and MCP server. 441 stars.

name: Claude Code — /skill-doctor, managedMcpServers & Cross-Machine Agents
hook: Three builds this week add features not yet covered in prior digests: /skill-doctor lists every installed skill with its context footprint so you can prune unused ones; managedMcpServers lets org admins push MCP servers to every user without individual config; and SendMessage/ListAgents now work cross-machine on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry — closing the multi-region agent gap. Also: --permission-prompts none denies all prompts automatically for unattended headless hosts.

name: awesome-claude-code-toolkit
hook: The most comprehensive structured resource list for Claude Code on GitHub — 135 agents across 10 categories, 35 curated skills (+400k via SkillKit), 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 14 MCP configs, and 26 companion apps. Peaked at #1 GitHub trending in February 2026 and now sits at 2.4k stars with active weekly PRs.
